# Agent Friendly Web

> Public website auditor and guided owner workspace created by Gabriel Mucchiut and incubated within Tokenizart.

Agent Friendly Web measures public evidence about how agents can discover, understand, and use a website. Its AF-0 to AF-5 framework is a proprietary methodology published for transparent use; it is not an official certification.

## Human language routes

- [Spanish canonical experience](https://agentfriendlyweb.dev/)
- [English experience](https://agentfriendlyweb.dev/en/)
- [Portuguese experience](https://agentfriendlyweb.dev/pt/)
- Human pages publish canonical and hreflang equivalents in Spanish, English and Portuguese.
- Machine contracts, schemas, APIs and well-known resources keep one canonical unprefixed URL and are not translated into divergent contracts.

## Important limits

- Public scans are read-only and do not authenticate to the target website.
- `llms.txt` is a community proposal, not a mandatory crawler standard.
- WebMCP is treated as an experimental W3C Community Group draft.
- The private owner dossier requires sign-in and must not be crawled or inferred.
- The repo-first read-only CLI and the public stateless MCP read-only server are deployed. MCP exposes only four bounded public tools and four public resources; A2A, WebMCP and x402 are not production capabilities.
- The publication capsule is a deployed private workflow for manual handoff. It prepares files, hashes and human approvals, but it does not modify the target website, call a CMS or deploy code.
- The AI Catalog links the OKF bundle as an Agent Friendly Web project convention; OKF v0.2 does not define a universal discovery endpoint.
- Owner-declared Registry content is displayed verbatim in every interface language; the platform does not silently translate or alter owner claims.
- The optional post-audit contact form is a local preview. It does not persist data or send email, and marketing choices remain separate and unchecked.
- The operational privacy notice is a candidate for legal review. It documents current technical processing and proposed retention targets; real contact, automated rights requests, retention jobs and product updates remain disabled.
- The canonical public origin now runs on the Cloudflare-native Vinext Worker. The protected canary, rollback-only Sites binding, retired surfaces and next gate remain separated in the dated infrastructure status.
